overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates a ZIP archive from a single 4D.File.
Creates a ZIP archive from a single 4D.Folder, optionally excluding the enclosing folder itself from the archive contents.

discriminatedBy.note: first arg is a 4D.Folder; only this overload accepts the options parameter

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates a ZIP archive from a full zip-structure description object, allowing per-entry destination paths, compression/encryption settings, a password, and a progress callback.

discriminatedBy.note: first arg is a plain Object describing compression/encryption/files rather than a single File/Folder

constraints: zipStructure object properties: compression (Integer constant: ZIP Compression standard [default]/LZMA/XZ/none), level (Integer 1-10 compression level; default depends on compression: 6 for standard, 4 for LZMA/XZ), encryption (Integer constant: ZIP Encryption AES128/AES192/AES256 [default if password set]/none [default if no password]), password (Text, used when encryption requires one), and files (a Collection of 4D.File/4D.Folder objects, or of objects with source: 4D.File-or-Folder, destination: Text relative path (optional), option: Integer such as ZIP Ignore invisible files or 0 (optional), and callback: 4D.Function receiving compression progress 0-100 in $1).
destinationFile should preferably use a '.zip' extension so the archive is recognized automatically by other software.

The returned status object has statusText (Text error message, e.g. 'Cannot open ZIP archive', 'Cannot create ZIP archive', 'Password is required for encryption'), status (Integer status code), and success (Boolean).

In the folderToZip overload, passing the ZIP Without enclosing folder constant in options compresses only the folder's contents (without it, decompressing recreates the enclosing folder, which is the default).
